answer.report_md: 本页要求生成器绘制单面板横向条形图，并在每个国家条上叠加2018年菱形点与2024年短竖线；条色还编码四类创新表现，EU另作高亮。数值均未印出，只能依据间隔20的横轴估读，且Belgium等处条端与竖线几乎重合，精确年份值较难区分。国家与年份通常足以定位，但105附近没有可唯一对应的标记，这是主要不确定处。

heading.subtitle: dimension
heading.unit_text: Score for dimension 3.1 in 2025 (indexed to the EU in 2018)

components.evidence: The panel overlays horizontal bars, diamond points, and short vertical ticks.
Country categories run down the left while coloured bars extend rightward.
Bar colours encode “Emerging innovators”, “Moderate innovators”, “Strong innovators”, and “Innovation leaders”.
“Score in 2024” is represented by a short vertical tick for every country.
The six-entry legend is placed beneath the horizontal axis title.
An italic line beginning “Note: All performance scores” appears below the legend.
The axis title reads “Score for dimension 3.1 in 2025 (indexed to the EU in 2018)”.
“Score for dimension 3.1 in 2025 (indexed to the EU in 2018)” sits below the x axis.
The scale is “indexed to the EU in 2018” and the note says scores are relative to it.
“Innovators” appears in blue immediately above the panel at left.
Only pale vertical gridlines cross the plot at 20-point x-axis intervals.
The “EU” bar is dark blue, unlike the four performance-group bar colours.
